## Question and short answer

Does the lab association-ML recipe calibrate well enough for ordinary exposure?
This registration has no calibration evidence yet. The bounded pilot will
check mechanics and cost; ordinary exposure remains pending production.

## Evidence

Frozen CSV summaries will be read from this study's own `results/pilot/`.

## Caveats

Tiny smoke and pilot rates cannot settle defaults. Coverage uses association-ML
pseudo-true values, with separate DWLS targets. Global rejection under latent
non-normality or model misspecification is descriptive.

## Reproduce

See `Rscript run_experiment.R --help`. Production requires separate authorization.
